notable_absence.finding: Round 21's appendix_5_python.json recorded a hard requirement on this exact endpoint (POST /analytics/library/{scope}/{library}): 'This request must also originate locally from a node that is running Analytics. Upload requests from non-local origins are blocked for security purposes.' This REST reference page - the canonical, generated documentation for that same endpoint - never mentions the restriction anywhere: not in the Description, Parameters, Responses, or Security sections. A reader consulting only this page would not learn the upload must be loopback-origin. Also absent: the 'Version: 0.1' declared in this page's own Version Information section is a much lower number than every sibling REST reference in this batch ('Version: 8.0'), with nothing on the page explaining the discrepancy - possibly a per-API-spec version distinct from the product release version, but not stated as such.

cross_component_finding: This page's two Security schemes attach different role requirements to different HTTP methods on what round 21 treated as a single concept (analytics:library-upload for the POST): write operations (POST create/update, DELETE) require Full Admin alone, while the read operation (GET, listing all libraries) accepts a three-role disjunction (Full Admin, Cluster Admin, Analytics Admin) - the same read/write asymmetry pattern this batch's analytics-rest-config/index.json found between its own six-role query endpoint and three-role config endpoint, now recurring a third time within a single page's own two security schemes.
cross_product_finding: No Capella-specific content appears on this page; library upload via multipart/form-data of a shiv-packaged binary is an on-premises Server administrative mechanism with no stated Capella equivalent, consistent with round 21's appendix_5_python.json finding.
